turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to change my phone number for the two-factor authentification

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: because I lost that phone

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, I can help you with that! One second, please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To start, can I have your full name and/or account ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Joseph Banter, but i don't have my account ID

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Joseph Banter.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No worries Joseph, and thanks! I've pulled up your account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you provide the previous phone number that you had saved with us?

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: A reason of 376-285-0809 has been recorded.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it, thanks!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Now, I need you to provide any 3 of the following items, if you have them:

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Zip code, telephone number, PIN number, username, password, email address, or the order ID of a previous purchase

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: josephbanter566@email.com, zip 3488, username josephbanter566

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Identity verification in progess ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hm, I wasn't able to verify your username. Do you have any other item that you could provide?

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Identity verification in progess ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright, thank you! What number would you like to update to?

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been updated with 376-285-6446.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Everything has been updated, thank you!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thank you

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem! Have a great day!

agentic.summary: Agent requested prohibited sensitive credentials and completed a phone-number change without required full verification.

findings.quote: Zip code, telephone number, PIN number, username, password, email address, or the order ID of a previous purchase
findings.explanation: Agent explicitly asked for a password and a PIN in a single prompt. The policy forbids asking for or writing down passwords or PINs; this is a major violation.

findings.quote: Everything has been updated, thank you!
findings.explanation: Agent confirmed the phone number change (system turn 21 shows the account was updated) but did not perform the required full verification for a phone change. The policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) before changing a phone number; the agent only pulled the account by name (system turn 6) and requested other items but did not collect the required account ID or an order ID before making the change.

full.summary: Agent asked for prohibited authentication data (password/PIN) and updated the customer's phone without completing the required full verification (order ID missing), then confirmed the update.

findings.quote: Zip code, telephone number, PIN number, username, password, email address, or the order ID of a previous purchase
findings.explanation: The agent explicitly asked for a PIN number and a password. The policy forbids asking for, repeating or writing out a password or PIN (major violation).

findings.quote: Alright, thank you! What number would you like to update to?
findings.explanation: The agent moved forward to request the new phone number without completing the 'full verification' required for changes to a phone (policy requires full name, account ID and order ID). Although the account was pulled up (system turn 6) and the agent requested any 3 items, the agent did not obtain the required order ID and proceeded.

findings.quote: Everything has been updated, thank you!
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed the phone number update after the system logged the change (system turn 21) despite not completing the mandated full verification — this is an account-action taken/confirmed with incomplete verification (major violation).

rag.summary: Agent pulled up account correctly but violated rules by asking for a password and PIN and by performing incomplete verification for a phone-number change. No other policy violations found in provided excerpts.

findings.quote: Zip code, telephone number, PIN number, username, password, email address, or the order ID of a previous purchase
findings.explanation: The agent explicitly asked for a PIN number and a password. Policy forbids asking for, repeating or writing out passwords or PINs; this is a major violation. Asking for non-required personal details in the same list (zip code, telephone) is unnecessary but secondary to the PIN/password violation.

findings.quote: Now, I need you to provide any 3 of the following items, if you have them:
findings.explanation: The customer requested a phone-number change (a change to phone). Policy requires full verification before changes to phone: full name, account ID and order ID. Although the agent pulled up the account (system turn 6) they asked for 'any 3' items from a broad list and did not require the specific combination mandated (account ID and order ID were not secured). This is a failure to perform the required full verification for a high-risk action.
